question:
What is the area of a quadrilateral ABCD, (shown below) in which sides AB and BC are equal, sides AD and CD are of lengths 5 cm and 13 cm. respectively, and side AD is perpendicular to the diagonal AC?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/341ff3136d6a5f0d3fc721017510a34bd749618a711406b724cd7edd31f5c064.png]
solution:
**Given:**

AB = BC = 10 cm

AD = 5 cm, CD = 13 cm

**Calculation:**

In Δ ADC

AC = √{CD² - AD²} = √{13² - 5²} = √144 = 12 cm

So,

Area of Δ ADC = 1/2 × AD × AC = 1/2 × 5 × 12 = 30 cm²
